{{Quote|I need a medic here, medic!|A clone trooper during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] calling a medic upon a fellow clone being shot|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''Clone medics''' or '''clone trooper medics'''<ref name="Kix">{{SWE|characters|kix|Kix}} {{C|source code}}</ref> were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were equipped to diagnose and [[Medic/Legends|treat]] wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

==History==
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Medic/Legends|medics]] were specifically bred to treat their fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] who were injured. On [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], these clones were given specialized equipment and the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] instructed them on how to medically treat the clone body.

==Equipment==
Clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] medics of [[Excelsior Company]] wore standard [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] markings, notably orange circles on the shoulder armor and an orange stripe on the helmet. Clone trooper medics carried [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and spare ammunition like other clones, as well as medical equipment. They usually carried two [[vibroscalpel]]s, one [[laser scalpel]], and two [[laser cauterizer]]s. They also had a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] that contained numerous bandages and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] products. The medics would often be accompanied by an [[FX-3 medical assistant droid|FX-3]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] to assist in diagnosing and treating injuries.<ref name="Lost">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''</ref>
